office_does: The assessor values every taxable property in Klickitat County each year, the basis for property tax bills.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Assessor Billi Jean Bare (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Klickitat County Assessor since 2023 and in the office since 2016; a state-accredited appraiser and the only candidate.
highlights: Assessor since 2023, in the office since 2016 [S1]
